description: Standard object manipulation for every entity (unless the entity is locked or overrides it): pinch an interactive part to press it, pinch anything else to grab and move it, pinch with the second hand to scale/rotate it with both hands.

bindings.description: Pinch an interactive part (registered via ctx.interactive) of a widget: delivers 'press' start/move/end to the widget.
Pinch near or point-and-pinch at an entity to move it rigidly with the hand, keeping the grab offset.
While one hand grabs an entity, pinch it with the other hand: move apart/together to scale, twist to rotate (yaw), move both to translate.
